exportDestination.title: Export Destination
exportDestination.summary: A configured sink for BI data exports
exportDestination.description: Represents a configured external warehouse sink (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS, BigQuery, Snowflake, SFTP, Postgres). Credentials live in an OpenConnector source; this schema only references the source by id (ADR-005). Used by the BI export pipeline as the upload target for an export job.

name.description: Friendly name for the destination (e.g. 'Production S3').
name.title: Name

connectorSourceId.description: UUID reference to an OpenConnector source holding the credentials. Credentials are never stored on this object.
connectorSourceId.title: Connector Source ID

pathTemplate.description: Template for the destination path, e.g. s3://bucket/pipelinq/{schema}/{partition}/. Placeholders: {schema}, {partition}, {run_id}, {timestamp}.
pathTemplate.title: Path Template

encryptionEnabled.description: Enable server-side encryption-at-rest for object-store destinations.
encryptionEnabled.title: Encryption Enabled

validationStatus.description: Result of the last connection test.
validationStatus.title: Validation Status

lastValidatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last connection test.
lastValidatedAt.title: Last Validated At

exportJob.title: Export Job
exportJob.summary: A configured, repeatable BI export task
exportJob.description: Represents a configured, repeatable export of one or more pipelinq schemas to an export destination. Supports full-refresh and incremental (watermark/CDC) modes, multiple formats, cron scheduling, row filters and a column allowlist for PII minimisation (GDPR).

sourceSchemas.description: List of pipelinq schema slugs to export.
sourceSchemas.title: Source Schemas

mode.description: Export mode: full re-export or incremental watermark/CDC.
mode.title: Mode

incrementalWatermarkColumn.description: Column name used for incremental tracking (e.g. updated_at). Required when mode = incremental.
incrementalWatermarkColumn.title: Incremental Watermark Column

enabled.description: Whether the job runs on its schedule. Defaults to false until tested.
enabled.title: Enabled

rowFilterExpression.description: Optional SQL-style row filter, applied before export. Example: status != 'deleted'.
rowFilterExpression.title: Row Filter Expression

columnAllowlist.description: If set, only these columns are exported; all others are dropped (PII minimisation).
columnAllowlist.title: Column Allowlist

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user UID of the job creator.
createdBy.title: Created By

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the job was created.
createdAt.title: Created At

exportRun.title: Export Run
exportRun.summary: One immutable execution of an export job (audit record)
exportRun.description: Records one execution of an export job. Serves as the immutable per-run audit record (ADR-009): row/byte/file counts, per-file manifest with checksums, watermark range, error state and destination acknowledgement.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run started (null while pending).
startedAt.title: Started At

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the run completed (null while running).
endedAt.title: Ended At

watermarkFrom.description: For incremental runs: start of the watermark range (previous run's watermarkTo).
watermarkFrom.title: Watermark From

watermarkTo.description: For incremental runs: end of the watermark range (max value observed this run).
watermarkTo.title: Watermark To

rowCount.description: Number of rows exported in this run.
rowCount.title: Row Count

byteCount.description: Total bytes written to the destination.
byteCount.title: Byte Count

fileManifestJson.description: Array of files written, each with path, size_bytes, sha256, rows_in_file, compression_used, upload_status.
fileManifestJson.title: File Manifest Json

errorMessage.description: Error description when status is failed or partial.
errorMessage.title: Error Message

destinationAck.description: Destination acknowledgement (S3 ETag, BigQuery load-job id, Snowflake query id, ...).
destinationAck.title: Destination Ack

exportSchemaSnapshot.title: Export Schema Snapshot
exportSchemaSnapshot.summary: The structure of a pipelinq schema at export time
exportSchemaSnapshot.description: Records the column structure of a pipelinq schema at the time of an export run, enabling schema-drift detection between runs (added/removed/changed columns).

pipelinqSchemaName.description: Name of the pipelinq schema captured (e.g. contact, lead).
pipelinqSchemaName.title: Pipelinq Schema Name

columnDefinitionsJson.description: Map of column names to their type/nullability, e.g. {"id":"uuid","email":"string|null"}.
columnDefinitionsJson.title: Column Definitions Json

comparedToPrevious.description: Changes from the prior run, e.g. ['added: phone', 'removed: legacy_field', 'changed: status (string -> enum)'].
comparedToPrevious.title: Compared To Previous
